items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: And then, Belton. From Florida. ... J.C. Belton from West Palm Beach, Florida.

ctx.x: What about the bands coming in from out of town?

Well, the first big band came to New Orleans. I know it was the first one. It was in the, in the, in the, in the, in the, in the early 30's. George E. Lee from Kansas City. Oh yeah? Was that a good band? Ooh, yes indeed. That's the first time I ever heard big time music. Mmhmm. And then, Belton. From Florida.
Belton? That's entirely new to me. I never heard of him before in my life. Belton. Belton. Featuring T Hound Slim.
